_comment: MCP server registration for the PR-review pipeline. Follows the same shape as Claude Code's .mcp.json (mcpServers: {name: {command, args, env}}) so it can be dropped in directly as .mcp.json at the repo root, or referenced from docker-compose. Both servers are spawned as local stdio subprocesses inside the agent-harness container -- no additional network egress required (see docker/docker-compose.yml network_mode notes).

pr-review-storage.description: Persistent memory: review-history.jsonl, calibration-log.jsonl. Classification: internal. See docs/mcp-configuration.md.

pr-review-retrieval.description: Vector retrieval over data/*.diff (TF-IDF, local/offline). Classification: public. See docs/mcp-configuration.md.

_role_tool_allowlist._comment: Enforceable version of docs/orchestration-diagram.md's Routing-and-Tool-Grant Map. Each server also enforces this same mapping independently in its own TOOL_GRANTS dict (mcp/storage_server.py, mcp/retrieval_server.py) via an optional _caller_role argument passed with every tools/call -- so the boundary holds even if the orchestrator config below is bypassed or misconfigured. Full CI-enforced policy testing is Workstream 4; this is the config both that work and today's agents rely on.
